items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: because he was a better musician than any of us, and that was Bill Clappinger

ctx.x: Oh, I would say around 11, 12 years old. That's all. Maybe 14 years, I don't know you. Not that old. No, we didn't ever leave that house for three years. We practiced until we were about 14. Then we began going out. Now there were a lot of older men in the crowd, and I wouldn't say older. Oh yeah, I know. Maybe 15, 16, they were old compared to us. But then when I got to be about 14, then we actually ventured out and began playing on Sunday night after we'd practiced all afternoon at the Reynolds' we'd go to some…
Were the winds in there or just strings?
